before: 2025 tort reform (SB 68). Since April 21, 2025, lawyers may suggest a dollar figure for pain and suffering only in closing argument, and only if it is rationally related to the evidence, even in pending cases (O.C.G.A. § 9-10-184). For injuries on or after that date, medical expenses are limited to the reasonable value of necessary care, and if you have health insurance the jury may hear what your insurer actually paid as well as the billed amount (O.C.G.A. § 51-12-1.1). Seat-belt non-use is now admissible evidence (O.C.G.A. § 40-8-76.1).
